title: Email Validator
subtitle: Validate email addresses online
description: Validate email addresses for correct format, domain existence, and deliverability. Get detailed validation reports with suggestions for improvement.

features.title: Format Validation
features.description: Check email format against RFC 5322 standards

features.title: Domain Check
features.description: Verify domain exists and has MX records

features.title: Disposable Email Detection
features.description: Identify temporary or disposable email addresses

features.title: Role Account Detection
features.description: Detect generic role-based emails (admin@, info@, etc.)

tips: Format validation is instant and free
Disposable emails may be valid but not ideal for business
Always validate on both client and server side
Consider rate limits for bulk validation
